Name: Debir, King of Eglon
Summary: Debir was king of Eglon and one of the five kings who allied against Gibeon and were defeated by Joshua.
KeyStory: Debir joined Adoni-zedek against Gibeon, fled to the cave at Makkedah, and was hanged with the other four kings.
LifeLesson: Alliances against God end in the same cave.
